purpose: Freeze the current headless Spreadsheet, Math and user-facing Data Analysis semantic boundary over existing System Master shared runtime authorities, preserve strong historical Spreadsheet implementation/qualification evidence without PASS transfer, and select current evidence/source admission rather than restarting Spreadsheet research or creating an Excel mini-system.

ownership.rule: EXCEL-QUAL-001 remains the Spreadsheet-specific oracle/qualification lineage and may define profile semantics, but it is not promoted into a new first-class system. Core supplies shared jobs, artifact custody, evidence, verification, routing, authorization, resources and persistence mechanics without becoming Spreadsheet semantic owner.

interaction_contract.user_outcome: Create, inspect, calculate, transform, analyze, verify and return spreadsheet/data-analysis artifacts through chat-first workflows while exposing material calculation, fidelity, safety and native-engine limitations before promotion.

owns: XLSX/XLSM package and workbook semantic interpretation
worksheets, cells, formulas, names, tables, data validation, conditional formatting and workbook dependency semantics
calculation-profile selection, cached-value freshness standing and recalculation evidence
charts, Pivot-family state, print/layout, drawings, hidden/protected state and opaque-part preservation requirements
macro, Office Script, external-link, external-data, add-in and UDF capability/risk classification
spreadsheet revision/conflict and round-trip preservation requirements
Spreadsheet-specific verification-plan composition over shared verification infrastructure
iPhone/chat review, progress, conflict and native-editor handoff semantics
does_not_own: a separate artifact store, durable job system, evidence database, verification authority, capability router, authorization system or resource governor
Core/DATA-001 physical persistence or canonical system databases
Book, Learning or Prose canonical records merely because they are represented in rows/columns
external refresh, macro execution or consequential data-source effects without explicit authority

owns: bounded symbolic calculation contracts where supported
units, precision, rounding, uncertainty and reproducibility semantics
explicit function-set/version identity for portable calculation
calculation receipts usable by Spreadsheet, Research, Learning, Book or other authorized consumers
does_not_own: domain-owned source truth or canonical records
silent numerical-method substitution that changes declared semantics
math_semantics.cross_owner_rule: A domain may consume Math results as evidence/derived values; only the receiving owner may admit those values into its canonical state.

owns: joins, aggregations, transformations, statistics and derived analytical views
analysis provenance, source-reference binding and deterministic recomputation requirements
does_not_own: Core physical persistence, migrations, backup/restore or canonical system-of-record mechanics
write authority over source-domain records without an explicit domain contract
database administration merely because SQL or tabular analysis is used
data_analysis_semantics.persistence_rule: Analysis state and artifacts may reference or use Core/DATA-001 storage primitives. A portfolio calculation, transformation or analysis result is derived evidence until an owning domain explicitly admits it.

calculation_profiles.name: STRUCTURAL_NO_CALC
calculation_profiles.rule: Cached values retain unknown freshness unless separately proven.

calculation_profiles.name: PORTABLE_DECLARED_FUNCTION_SET
calculation_profiles.rule: Function set/version and numerical semantics are explicit; never promoted to generic Excel parity.

calculation_profiles.name: EXCEL_CLOUD_SERVICE
calculation_profiles.rule: Tenant, storage, authorization, API eligibility and provider limits are prerequisites.

calculation_profiles.name: EXCEL_NATIVE_DESKTOP
calculation_profiles.rule: Exact Excel product/build/channel and workbook Compatibility Version must be bound.

calculation_profiles.name: EXCEL_NATIVE_MOBILE_REVIEW
calculation_profiles.rule: No macro execution, external-data update, new Pivot creation or unsupported authoring claim is inferred.

calculation_profiles.name: EXCEL_WEB_INTEROP_REVIEW
calculation_profiles.rule: Unsupported features require truthful handoff; they are never silently removed.

calculation_profiles.name: ACTIVE_CONTENT_NATIVE_CONTROLLED
calculation_profiles.rule: Default is preserve-disabled, not execute. Explicit authority and a qualified native environment are mandatory.

verification_law.candidate_identity_rule: Every required profile must bind the same exact admitted artifact candidate/digest unless an authorized repair creates a new candidate, in which case prior passes are historical and the campaign restarts.
verification_law.missing_or_failed_profile_rule: Blocks final promotion; one passing profile may not launder a failed, missing, unavailable or human/native-required profile.
verification_law.repair_rule: Repair is bounded, profile-specific and effect-authorized; repair cannot create Spreadsheet-local artifact/evidence/job/persistence authority.
verification_law.evidence_authority: Shared System Master verification/evidence authorities remain canonical; Spreadsheet oracles contribute specialist evidence only.

proven: real XLSX OOXML package detection and package-safety path
specialized semantic routing under EXCEL-QUAL-001 lineage
repair invalidates earlier passes for final-candidate standing
portable campaign integration with Spreadsheet VP-STRUCT
bounded detection of formula effect surfaces such as WEBSERVICE, RTD, CALL, REGISTER.ID and external HTTP/HTTPS HYPERLINK

historical_evidence_rule: These exact commits and Library artifacts are preserved implementation/qualification evidence. They do not transfer PASS to main, a reconstructed source tree, a future import, a changed dependency set or a new Git SHA. Current admission must bind and qualify its own exact subject.
known_open_gaps: current GitHub-native source/custody identity of the strongest Spreadsheet implementation chain
full formula grammar/semantic coverage and explicit compatibility/version behavior
broad calculation correctness beyond declared portable function subsets
dependency graph, dirty-state, cache freshness and recalculation semantics across unsupported/conditional functions
complete workbook fidelity and non-destructive round-trip preservation
controlled active-content, external-data and UDF/add-in execution routes
native Excel desktop target qualification with exact product/build/channel
mobile/web interop qualification for declared supported capabilities
live Core/DATA-001 persistence integration where required by product workflows
security_and_effect_invariants: XLSX/XLSM package intake remains bounded and path-safe.
DTD/external-entity/XInclude/external-schema expansion is disabled in portable XML verification paths.
Macros, Office Scripts, add-ins, UDFs, external links and external data are inventory/preserve/deny-by-default unless a separate controlled effect route is explicitly authorized.
A workbook that needs native Excel for a required claim returns TARGET_NATIVE_REQUIRED rather than substituting portable evidence.
Cached values without a bound recalculation/freshness receipt cannot be treated as current calculated truth.
No Spreadsheet operation may silently convert an analysis result into another domain's canonical record.

selected_next_action.instruction: Locate the strongest dependency-valid preserved Spreadsheet source/evidence chain after SPREADSHEET-VP-SECURITY-007; determine exact source custody and ancestry; reconcile later Spreadsheet profile/campaign packets without assuming branch chronology equals authority; produce one current import candidate and exact manifest; then import/requalify only the current exact subject under HEADLESS-COMPUTE-DATA-001. Do not restart EXCEL-QUAL research or claim full Spreadsheet completion from VP-STRUCT/VP-SECURITY alone.

global_sequence_rule: This contract is independent work-ahead. It does not replace CURRENT-AUTHORITY.central_next_objective; SYSTEM-MASTER-DOCUMENT-R4-GITHUB-NATIVE-SOURCE-IMPORT-AND-EXACT-SUBJECT-QUALIFICATION-002 remains the central product-root objective until completed, blocked by an externally unresolved prerequisite, or explicitly superseded.
completion_rule: The architecture contract is complete when Spreadsheet, Math and user-facing Data Analysis semantics, shared-authority boundaries, calculation profiles, verification law, preserved evidence and current-admission successor are explicit without creating a new system or duplicating Core persistence/verification authorities. Implementation readiness/product completion is not implied.
